Actual Article Body:
The family of Jeffrey Epstein victim Virginia Giuffre, who died by suicide in 2025, is claiming that the office of Rep. Jeff Crank (R-CO) brushed off a request to meet with their congressman to discuss a bill compelling the release of the Epstein files.

Giuffre’s brother and sister-in-law, Sky and Amanda Roberts, appeared in a new advertisement Monday for Crank’s Democratic challenger, Jessica Killin, slamming Crank and accusing him over running cover for President Donald Trump. The pair lives in Colorado’s 5th District, which Crank represents.
